title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has released a security advisory for the Linux kernel packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10, addressing multiple vulnerabilities including issues in SCTP stream handling, net/mlx5 buffer overflow, sunrpc TLS handshake race conditions, SMB client permission bits, Open vSwitch use-after-free, and PCI/sysfs lockdown checks. These updates also include bug fixes and enhancements. The kernel is a critical component of the operating system, and these fixes improve overall system security.
